intro.h2: Tile work where the details get settled before the first cut
paragraphs: Antonio's Tile is a Ypsilanti tile contractor that has worked under the same name since 1977. Most of the work is in bathrooms: walk-in showers, full bath remodels and master shower re-tiles. The crew also sets kitchen backsplashes, mosaics and tile floors.

What reviewers notice is the planning. Antonio sits down with you before any tile goes up and settles the small choices that make a shower work every day: where the recessed shelves go, which pattern runs on the walls and how the trim finishes the edges. One customer said that is how she got exactly the shower she pictured. Reviewers also describe the pricing as fair and reasonable and the work as high quality.

services.h2: What an Ypsilanti tile contractor can do for your home

items.name: Shower tile and shower re-tiles
items.blurb: New walk-in showers and full re-tiles of tired master bath showers. Recessed niches are planned with you so shampoo and soap have a home, and the floor tile is set to the drain. One reviewer had her master shower re-tiled and said she got the shower she envisioned.

image.alt: White subway tile shower wall with three recessed niches trimmed in brass

items.name: Bathroom remodeling
items.blurb: From the floor up: tile floors, tub and shower walls, and the tile around the vanity. Projects range from a classic gray and white checkerboard floor to bold navy wall tile with brass fixtures. Bathroom remodels are among the jobs Google reviewers mention most.

image.alt: Bathroom with gray and white checkerboard floor tile, dark cherry vanity and glass shower

items.name: Kitchen backsplashes
items.blurb: A backsplash changes how a whole kitchen feels. Antonio's Tile has set deep navy herringbone behind a kitchen sink and glossy white subway tile above stone counters. Backsplash installation is one of the jobs Google reviewers call out by name.

image.alt: Kitchen with navy herringbone tile backsplash, white shaker cabinets and white countertop under a wide window

items.name: Mosaics and tile floors
items.blurb: Hexagon shower floors, patterned floor tile and hand-set mosaic medallions. In September 2026 the business shared a mosaic it installed on its Google profile. Grout work is another topic that comes up in Google reviews, which matters most on floors and shower pans.

image.alt: Shower floor in black hexagon mosaic tile with a square brass drain and white subway tile walls

items.title: The details are agreed up front
items.text: A reviewer said Antonio brought her in to go over recess shelving, tile pattern and trim before moving forward, so the finished shower matched what she pictured.

items.title: They show up when they say
items.text: Matt R. wrote that Tony and Gino showed up when they said they would and worked hard until the job was done. In his words, the price was fair and the work was excellent.

items.title: Bring the tile you already chose
items.text: Antonio's Tile installs tile bought from The Home Depot, The Tile Shop and Lowe's, so you can shop where you like and still get a dedicated tile installer.

items.title: A name around since 1977
items.text: The Antonio's Tile logo and Facebook page both say "Since 1977." Today the business holds a 4.7-star rating from 29 Google reviews.

about.h2: Antonio and Gino, on the job
about.text: Antonio's Tile works out of Eastlawn Avenue in Ypsilanti and has used the same name since 1977. The people homeowners meet are Antonio and Gino, the pair reviewers name when they talk about their new showers and bathrooms. Antonio is the one who sits down with you to go over niches, layout and trim, and one customer called him an excellent communicator. The owner's replies to Google reviews often end with "God bless." The crew installs the tile you pick from big stores and specialty shops, including the mosaic and pattern work you see in the photos.

image.alt: Antonio's Tile installer setting a blue and white mosaic medallion into a white subway tile wall

steps.title: Go over the details

steps.title: Tile is set

service_area.h2: Tile work in Ypsilanti, Ann Arbor and Washtenaw County
service_area.text: Antonio's Tile is based at 2770 Eastlawn Ave in Ypsilanti, Michigan. Its Facebook posts name Ypsilanti Township and Ann Arbor as places it works, and tag a finished project in Washtenaw County, Michigan. Most jobs are showers, bathrooms and kitchen backsplashes in homes around these towns. If you live nearby and are not sure whether your street is covered, call (734) 623-3274 and ask before you book an estimate.

items.a: Yes. Antonio's Tile advertises free estimates on its Facebook page. Call (734) 623-3274 to set one up, and describe the shower, bathroom, backsplash or floor you have in mind so Antonio knows what the job involves before you meet to go over the details.

items.q: Can you install tile I already bought?
items.a: Yes. Antonio's Tile says it installs tile from The Home Depot, The Tile Shop and Lowe's Home Improvement. Bring your choice to the estimate, or the boxes if you already bought them, and Antonio can talk through layout, niches, pattern and trim for that tile before work starts.

The shop is at 2770 Eastlawn Ave, Ypsilanti, MI 48197. Facebook posts name Ypsilanti Township, Ann Arbor and Washtenaw County as the area it works in. For a home anywhere else nearby, call (734) 623-3274 and ask whether your address is in range before booking.

Google lists Sunday to Thursday 7 AM to 8 PM, Friday 7:30 AM to 8 PM, and Saturday open 24 hours, so there is a window every day of the week. Call (734) 623-3274, or email antonialmurdoc@gmail.com if you would rather send photos of your space first.

items.q: How soon can we walk on the new tile?
items.a: Antonio's Tile recommends waiting 24 to 48 hours before walking on freshly installed tile. That gives the mortar time to set so tiles do not shift, sink or crack the grout lines. Ask at the end of your job when your new floor or shower pan is ready to use.
